title: Invoice
description: Billing invoice record. Billing Agent enforces duplicate prevention via idempotency key, validates insurance coverage, and tracks payment status with SLA-based escalation for overdue claims.

visitId.description: Reference to the Visit this invoice covers.

idempotencyKey.description: Composite unique key for duplicate detection. Generated as SHA-256 hash of: patientId + visitId + treatmentCodes (sorted) + invoiceDate. Billing Agent rejects submissions with matching idempotency key.

patientResponsibility.description: Amount patient must pay out of pocket.

treatmentCodes.description: Treatment/procedure codes billed. Must match codes in the insurance policy's coveredCodes for claim approval.

insurancePolicyId.description: Reference to the Insurance Policy. Billing Agent validates policy is not expired at time of claim.

status.description: Current invoice status. 'overdue' triggers SLA-based escalation.

submittedToInsurer.description: Whether claim has been submitted to insurance provider.

rejectionReason.description: Reason for claim rejection if applicable.

mismatchDetected.description: True if treatment codes do not match insurance coverage plan. Claim held pending review.

missingDocumentation.description: List of documents required but not yet provided for valid claim.

daysOutstanding.description: Number of days since invoice was created and remains unpaid.

slaBreached.description: True if daysOutstanding > 30. Triggers auto-escalation to billing manager.

applied.description: Whether a manual override was applied to this invoice.

justification.description: REQUIRED when applied=true. Documented justification for override. Logged to audit trail.

overriddenBy.description: User ID of person who applied the override.

manualOverride.description: Manual override with mandatory justification — logged to audit trail.

isDuplicate.description: True if idempotency key matches an existing invoice.

existingInvoiceId.description: ID of the existing invoice that matches, if duplicate.
